_note: Source-file integrity pins (SHA-256) for tools/maps/build.py. A matching hash shows that the file is the one that was pinned; it does not show that its boundaries are correct or match any live official source. Market areas are defined by unit lists and street cuts in geometry.py and boundaries.py, not by ward lines; a new ward or boundary vintage must not change them silently. build.py refuses to run if an input differs from this list unless ACCEPT_NEW_SOURCES=1 is set, and the change must be reviewed (tools/maps/audit.py, docs/map-geography.md) before this file is updated. The six Overture entries are replacement inputs regenerated after the originals were lost; the original hashes are kept under original_overture_inputs.
